title: Little's Law
summary: 在合适的稳态条件下，系统平均在制品数等于有效吞吐率乘以平均停留时间。
statement: Average number in system = average effective arrival rate × average time in system.
assumptions: 采用与 Little's Law 相容的稳定/守恒条件
doesNotImply: 降低 WIP 是缩短交付周期的唯一方法
engineeringImplications: 当吞吐率近似固定时，降低平均 WIP 会降低平均 cycle time
WIP limit 是一种工程策略，而不是定理本身

sources.label: John D. C. Little (1961), A Proof for the Queuing Formula: L = λW
